name: Daikaya

identity.name: Daikaya
notes: One Penn Quarter address contains two explicitly separate restaurant concepts: the walk-in Ramen Shop on the first floor and the reservation-based Izakaya on the second floor. Ramen is not served upstairs.

sources.excerpt: Official homepage identifies the second-floor Izakaya and first-floor Ramen Shop as separate concepts in one Daikaya location.
Official first-floor page identifies 705 6th St NW, Washington, DC 20001, phone 202-589-1600, and walk-in ramen service.
Official second-floor page identifies the same 705 6th St NW location and states ramen is unavailable upstairs.

Current tabbed official catalog covers Hand Roll, Izakaya second floor, Ramen first floor, and Izakaya bar happy hour. It includes item names, descriptions, product-specific peanut/fish warnings, and floor boundaries.
Exact-location Toast catalog at 705 6th St NW was fully enumerated. It adds UCC Kona Coffee and Calpico, repeats ramen products and modifiers, and publishes an allergy-accommodation limit.
Official-domain document search found historical menu PDFs but no current public allergen matrix, nutrition guide, or ingredient table.
Targeted exact-location search found current menus and a third-party anecdote about an on-request allergen menu, but no current restaurant-issued public matrix.
A third-party anecdote reports that an allergen menu was available upon request on a prior visit; no dated, current, restaurant-issued matrix is published or retrievable from the source.

summary: Identity confirmed at 705 6th St NW with separate first-floor Ramen Shop and second-floor Izakaya service scopes. The current food/nonalcoholic catalog contains 74 canonical presentations across five current surfaces. All 91 frozen rows reconcile exactly once (59 exact, 4 normalized, 4 equivalent presentations, 19 stale, 5 artifacts); 14 current products are new to the freeze. All four required allergen-matrix searches were completed and the public formal matrix is accurately unavailable. 38 products retain current positive-only direct evidence, and no frozen-only allergen claims were carried forward.
proposedChanges: Publish floor-specific first-floor ramen and second-floor izakaya catalogs under the single confirmed Penn Quarter location.
Consolidate happy-hour discounts, Toast duplicates, and legacy alternate menu presentations while retaining genuine service-specific products.
Preserve current product-specific positive allergen evidence and the Toast accommodation limit; leave unsupported negatives and cross-contact claims empty.

findings.finding: Daikaya is one address with two explicitly separate floor concepts; ramen is not served in the second-floor Izakaya.
A third-party source reports an allergen menu may have been available on request, but no current restaurant-issued public matrix was retrievable.
The current linked takeout catalog states that gluten, soy, seaweed, and wheat requests cannot be accommodated.
